title: Urinary Tract Infection & Complicated Pyelonephritis Masterclass
description: Complicated UTI、Acute Pyelonephritis 與 Emphysematous Pyelonephritis 之專科課程。

sections.title: Module 1: Uropathogenic E. coli Virulence Factors & Host Mucosal Immunity
sections.content:
### 1. Virulence Factor & Pathogenesis Matrix

| Virulence Factor | Structural / Biochemical Feature | Primary Function in UTI Pathogenesis | Clinical Association |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Type 1 Fimbriae | FimH Adhesin at Tip | Binds Mannosylated Glycoproteins on Uroplakins | Bladder Colonization (Cystitis) |
| P Fimbriae (PapG) | PapG Adhesin Recognizes Gal(alpha 1-4)Gal | Binds Digalactoside Receptors on Renal Epithelium | Upper Tract Invasiveness (Pyelonephritis) |
| Hemolysin A (HlyA) | Pore-Forming Cytotoxin | Lyses Erythrocytes & Renal Tubular Cells | Tissue Damage & Cytokine Release |
| Aerobactin | Siderophore Iron-Acquisition System | Scavenges Host Iron under Low-Iron Urinary Environment | Bacterial Survival & Proliferation |

### 2. High-Yield Differential Comparison Table

| Feature | Uncomplicated Cystitis | Acute Uncomplicated Pyelonephritis | Emphysematous Pyelonephritis (EPN) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Primary Pathogen | Uropathogenic E. coli (80–90%) | Uropathogenic E. coli | E. coli, Klebsiella pneumoniae, Proteus |
| Patient Risk Factors | Healthy Young Women | Healthy Young Women | Poorly Controlled Diabetes Mellitus (85–90%) |
| Imaging Finding | Not Indicated | Focal Hypodensity (Wedge-shaped) | Parenchymal Gas Accumulation on CT Scan |
| Mortality & Urgency | Low (< 0.1%) | Low with Antibiotics | High (15–20%); Requires Urgent Percutaneous Drainage |

### 3. Pathophysiological Decision Tree

Uropathogenic E. coli Ascends Urethra ➔ FimH Adhesin Binds Uroplakin Ia & Ib on Superficial Umbrella Cells ➔ Invasion & Formation of Intracellular Bacterial Communities (IBCs) ➔ P Fimbriae (PapG) Mediates Renal Parenchymal Adhesion ➔ Activation of TLR4 Signaling ➔ Neutrophil Recruitment & Tubulointerstitial Suppurative Inflammation ➔ Acute Pyelonephritis.

### 4. Conceptual Trap Analysis

**Trap**: Asymptomatic Bacteriuria 在所有病人中皆需要投予抗生素治療。
**Analysis**: 根據 IDSA 指引，Pregnant Women Urologic Procedures 的患者外，其他族群（包括老年人、糖尿病患者、留置導尿管者及停經後女性）之 Asymptomatic Bacteriuria 均不建議治療。濫用抗生素無法預防症狀性 UTI，反而極易誘發 MDR 菌株產生。

sections.title: Module 2: Emphysematous Pyelonephritis & Complicated Renal Abscess Management
sections.content:
### 1. EPN Classification & Therapeutic Strategy Matrix

| EPN Class (Huang & Tseng) | CT Scan Radiological Findings | Preferred Initial Management | Success Rate / Prognosis |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Class 1 | Gas confined strictly to Collecting System (Emphysematous Pyelitis) | Medical Antibiotic Therapy +/- Stenting | High (> 90%) |
| Class 2 | Gas confined to Renal Parenchyma without Perinephric Extension | Medical Therapy + Percutaneous Catheter Drainage (PCD) | High (> 80%) |
| Class 3A | Gas / Abscess extends into Perinephric Space | Antibiotics + Urgent PCD | Moderate; Emergency Nephrectomy if PCD Fails |
| Class 3B | Gas / Abscess extends into Pararenal Space | Antibiotics + Urgent PCD | Moderate; Emergency Nephrectomy if PCD Fails |
| Class 4 | Solitary Kidney or Bilateral EPN | Antibiotics + Urgent Bilateral PCD | High Mortality Risk; Nephrectomy Last Resort |

### 2. Pathophysiological Decision Tree

Poorly Controlled Diabetes + High Tissue Glucose ➔ Ischemic Renal Hypoperfusion ➔ Infection by Mixed Acid Fermenting Microorganisms ➔ Anaerobic Fermentation of Glucose & Proteins ➔ Accumulation of Nitrogen, Hydrogen, Carbon Dioxide & Oxygen Gases ➔ Gas Dissection through Renal Parenchyma & Fascial Planes (Emphysematous Pyelonephritis) ➔ Emergency CT Scan + Percutaneous Drainage (PCD) + Broad-Spectrum Antibiotics.

### 3. Conceptual Trap Analysis

**Trap**: 對於 Class 3/4 EPN 患者，Emergency Nephrectomy。
**Analysis**: 現代指引與 Huang & Tseng Bosniak Category證明，Percutaneous Catheter Drainage, PCD 能夠保留腎臟組織並顯著降低死亡率。急診腎切除術僅保留用於 PCD 引流失敗、多重器官衰竭或廣泛破壞無法修復的病例。

sections.title: Module 3: Xanthogranulomatous Pyelonephritis & Chronic Tubulointerstitial Sequelae
sections.content:
### 1. Diagnostic Feature Matrix

| Feature | Xanthogranulomatous Pyelonephritis (XGP) | Renal Cell Carcinoma (RCC) | Malakoplakia |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Pathognomonic Histopathology | Lipid-Laden Foamy Macrophages (Xanthoma Cells) | Clear Cells with Abundant Glycogen/Lipid | Michaelis-Gutmann Bodies (Targetoid Calcifications) |
| Predisposing Factor | Chronic Staghorn Calculi (Proteus / E. coli) | Smoking, VHL Mutation | Chronic E. coli Infection in Immunocompromised Host |
| Key Radiological Sign | Bear Paw Sign on CT Scan | Heterogeneous Mass with Hypervascularity | Solitary/Multiple Yellowish Mucosal Plaques |

### 2. Conceptual Trap Analysis

**Trap**: 在 CT 上將 XGP 的 Bear Paw Sign RCC 而放過慢性感染源。
**Analysis**: XGP Staghorn Calculus 與擴張的腎盞，Foamy Macrophages 替代。這是一種嚴重的慢性毀損性感染性疾病，Nephrectomy 通常為根治手段。
